Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating carrying animals or persons in pickup beds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to carrying persons or animals in pickup truckbeds; and amending RCW 46.61.660.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.61.660 and 1997 c 190 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) It shall be unlawful for any person to transport any livinganimal on the running board, fenders, hood, or other outside part ofany vehicle, including the bed of a pickup truck, unless suitableharness, cage, or enclosure be provided and so attached as to protectsuch animal from falling or being thrown therefrom. (2) It shall be unlawful for any person to transport any personsupon the running board, fenders, hood, or other outside part of anyvehicle, ((except that this provision shall)) including the bed of apickup truck. (a) This subsection (2) does not apply to the outside part of avehicle that is equipped with seats with seatbelts and the person issecurely fastened in the seatbelt. (b) This subsection (2) does not apply to authorized emergency p. 1 HB 1077vehicles or to solid waste collection vehicles that are engaged incollecting solid waste or recyclables on route at speeds of twentymiles per hour or less.
